say:3:1620869003:1.text: They defeated the Hypofiends! Hausburg is safe again because of them!
say:3:1620869003:1.source_cn: 是那些解决了魔物袭击事件的冒险家！多亏了他们，咱们豪斯...

say:4:1620869004:1.text: Thank goodness they solved everything in just one day! Any longer and I'd have blown all my savings on their reward!
say:4:1620869004:1.source_cn: 要是再多拖几天，我家里那点财产就都得用来付酬金了。还好...

say:9:1620869007:1.text: W-Wow, they're way too enthusiastic! It's a bit much to handle...
say:9:1620869007:1.source_cn: 他、他们也太热情了吧！真是有点招架不来……

say:10:1620869008:1.text: Hmm, something doesn't feel right... Magister Merlin, did you catch what they said?

say:13:1620869009:0.text: Yeah, that seems odd to me as well. Wouldn't the villagers want us to stick around longer to make sure the Hypofiends are really gone?
say:13:1620869009:0.source_cn: 是的，我也觉得这点有些奇怪。出于安全考虑，镇民不是应该...

say:14:1620869010:0.text: But they kept saying the attacks are over and that Hausburg is safe. I have a feeling... they actually want us to leave sooner rather than later.
say:14:1620869010:0.source_cn: 但刚刚那些人却一直在说袭击事件结束，豪斯镇已经安全了。...

say:15:1620869011:0.text: Tsk, what are these people up to? Could there be something going on that we don't know?!
say:15:1620869011:0.source_cn: 欸……他们到底想做什么？难道这其中还有什么我们不知道的...

say:16:1620869012:0.text: Relax, Pippa. This could actually work in our favor.
say:16:1620869012:0.source_cn: 别紧张，皮帕，这对我们来说并不是坏事。

say:17:1620869013:0.text: Their desperation has given us an opening for investigation.
say:17:1620869013:0.source_cn: 他们的行动太急不可耐，反而弄巧成拙，露出了破绽，让我们...

say:18:1620869014:0.text: When the villagers came at us just now, some stayed calm and kept their distance. Did anyone notice?
say:18:1620869014:0.source_cn: 你们有没有注意到，刚才那群镇民凑上来围着我们的时候，另...

say:19:1620869015:0.text: These people might have the answers we're looking for.
say:19:1620869015:0.source_cn: 而这些人，很可能就是我们调查的突破口。

say:20:1620869016:0.text: Ah, you're right! They were observing us from afar!
say:20:1620869016:0.source_cn: 啊！没错，我想起来了，的确有几个人一直站在人群外看着我们！

say:21:1620869017:0.text: I thought they were up to no good, so I kept an eye on them... Turns out I completely misread the situation.
say:21:1620869017:0.source_cn: 我一开始以为那些人不怀好意，所以就多看了几眼……没想到...

say:22:1620869018:0.text: Nice work, Pippa! Now we know who to go after!
say:22:1620869018:0.source_cn: 哈哈，这样找起人来就更精准了。多亏了你，皮帕！

say:26:1620869020:1.text: The first is <style="highlight">Terrence, the guard captain</style>. He is said to know more about Hypofiends than anyone else in Hausburg.

say:28:1620869021:1.text: Next is <style="highlight">Zandra, the scholar</style> Terrence brought in to study the Hypofiends. She had a conversation with Terrence earlier, but it didn't end well.
